tasks.subject: Task 0: Astro scaffold and tooling
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Land an Astro project at the repo root that builds an empty page.

**Files:** package.json, package-lock.json, .nvmrc, astro.config.mjs, tsconfig.json, src/pages/index.astro, .gitignore

**Verify:** `rm -rf dist && npm run build && ls dist/index.html`

```json:metadata
{"files":["package.json","astro.config.mjs",".nvmrc","tsconfig.json","src/pages/index.astro",".gitignore"],"verifyCommand":"npm install && npm run build && ls dist/index.html","acceptanceCriteria":["npm install succeeds","npm run build produces dist/index.html","dist node_modules .astro gitignored","Node 20 pinned in .nvmrc"]}
```

tasks.description:
**Goal:** Port global CSS and page-shell head into a reusable Astro layout.

**Files:** src/layouts/Base.astro, src/styles/global.css, src/pages/index.astro, public/favicon.svg

**Verify:** `npm run build && npm run preview` — eyeball dark theme + stars + glows.

```json:metadata
{"files":["src/layouts/Base.astro","src/styles/global.css","src/pages/index.astro","public/favicon.svg"],"verifyCommand":"npm run build && npm run preview","acceptanceCriteria":["global.css has tokens base typography container section background","Base.astro has meta title fonts og favicon","placeholder renders with dark theme stars glows"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 8: akdRef build-time validator integration
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Astro integration validating akdRef paths against akd-suite tree at build start. Fail-loud on broken paths; skip on network failure.

**Files:** integrations/akd-ref-validator.js, integrations/akd-ref-validator.test.mjs; astro.config.mjs

**Verify:** `node --test integrations/akd-ref-validator.test.mjs && npm run build`; induce bad path → fails; offline mode → succeeds with warning.

```json:metadata
{"files":["integrations/akd-ref-validator.js","integrations/akd-ref-validator.test.mjs","astro.config.mjs"],"verifyCommand":"node --test integrations/akd-ref-validator.test.mjs && npm run build","acceptanceCriteria":["runs at astro build start","clean build validates and reports","bad path fails with clear error","offline mode skips with warning","unit tests pass"]}
```
